analysis.narrativeEn:

· Significantly below SMA100 ($148.49)/SMA200 ($124.07): sustained long-term weak trend strength.
· 52-week position (27.1%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.9→43.3): exited oversold, now consolidating in neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6.3695→-1.0531): improvement confirmed, potential entry into weak convergence phase.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $118.37): consolidating near the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($99.87): support confirmed based on pivot and 5-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($128.48): resistance confirmed based on 20-day high and Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation): attempting a rebound amidst weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.84x): subdued volume, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): directional uncertainty, meeting conditions for wait-and-see.
